doc.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995

title: Cab Calloway pays for Hinton's first child
summary: Calloway tells Hinton to have the baby on him and covers the costs; Hinton praises him as a man and says too little has been written about him.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Cab also, had that front, that would scare people a little bit too. But you knew the kind of person he really is, for instance with your first born.

Oh, that’s right, well I says, “Cab my wife is pregnant.” He say, “Yeah, mine too.” He say, “Have this one on me.” So the baby was born, you know, Charlotte was born, and three months later we’re in California and I’m trying to make a two o’clock feed and make the gig that night and Mona’s half sick, and Cab says to me, “Look man I told you to have that baby on me. Find out from Mona how much it costs for everything.” Back in those days it cost about $300 for prenatal care. And he just laid it out to me, man, it was like manna from heaven. And when my daughter got married, he was right there, “That’s my girl.” He was an amazing man, really. And still there hasn’t been that much written about him, and I hope those young people will get to interview some people that worked
for him to really be able to write what a great personality he was. He wasn’t that much older. I’m 85, Cab was 87, 88, but he was so far ahead of us in being —
